title: Introducing the Tech Accountability Fund and a Call for Proposals
funder: Collaboration on International ICT Policy for East and Southern Africa (CIPESA)

timing.quote: The deadline for applications is February 16, 2024.

budget.quote: Grant sizes will range from USD 5,000 to USD 20,000 subject to demonstrated need.

summary.value: Grants for civil society initiatives tackling tech accountability and electoral harms in Africa.
summary.quote: The Collaboration on International ICT Policy for East and Southern Africa (CIPESA) has partnered with Digital Action to support work on tech accountability in Sub-Saharan Africa in the run up to and during the “Year of Democracy” in 2024.

eligibility.quote: The Fund responds to these key concerns in the Year of Democracy and to the scant resources to African civil society entities that are working to counter tech harms.
